title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Customize the Role Center
summary: A blog series covering multiple aspects of customizing Role Centers in Business Central, including AL development techniques, cue display optimization, and agent customization for tailored user experiences.
key_points: Role Centers can be customized using AL code to extend functionality and user interface elements
Cues display limitations (999+ cap) can be worked around to show actual numbers
Pages can be configured to bypass the Role Center on application launch
Role Explorer supports adding custom pages, reports, and queries for navigation customization
Agent icons in Role Centers can be hidden for simplified user interface
